concerns.text: FR-001 references "See US‑1", but no identifier US‑1 is defined anywhere in the document; the user stories are titled "User Story 1" etc. This breaks traceability of requirements to user stories.
FR-004 cites "See US‑2", yet there is no US‑2 identifier; the adaptive scheduler is described in User Story 2. The cross‑reference is undefined.
FR-006 includes "See US‑3, FR‑009" but US‑3 does not exist; the statistical validation is covered by User Story 3.
FR-007 cites "See US‑3" which is undefined.

FR-008 references "See US‑3, FR‑011"; US‑3 is undefined, and FR‑011 is a separate requirement that duplicates the functionality of FR‑008 (both require leave‑one‑out cross‑validation of a quadratic model). This redundancy creates ambiguity about which requirement is authoritative.
FR-010 cites "See US‑2" which is undefined.
FR-011 repeats the leave‑one‑out cross‑validation requirement already stated in FR‑008, leading to potential duplication and confusion about expected implementation.
